one_line: SaaS e-commerce platform with broad REST Management APIs, GraphQL Storefront API, and webhooks for managing stores programmatically.
auth_notes: API credentials = store_hash + access token created under Settings > API Accounts with chosen scopes, sent as X-Auth-Token header; single-click apps use OAuth2 (client id/secret) for marketplace apps; storefront GraphQL uses its own storefront API token.
self_serve_notes: Free 15-day trial store (sandbox) to generate API credentials solo; after trial a paid plan is required. Docs walk through sandbox creation + API account setup.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Large REST Management API (catalog/products, orders, customers, carts, checkout, payments, price lists, channels, settings) plus GraphQL Storefront API; API reference with Request Runner
api_surface.webhook_note: Webhooks for store events (orders, products, customers, categories, carts) delivered to HTTPS endpoints

existing_mcp.note: Official BigCommerce MCP server exists (bigcommerce/mcp); docs also advertise an MCP for connecting AI agents to BigCommerce developer docs

evidence.note: Fetched text confirms free trial sandbox store, API Accounts with scopes, X-Auth-Token, REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, MCP AI Agent setup

agent_notes: Simple token auth via API Accounts; free trial store makes first call quick. Official MCP server exists.
